How this case reached the office

How it startedThe client's own application
Client accountThe client signs in for themselves

ViTally records office work only. It sends no email, no letter and no text message.

Screening checks

Recorded

The screening checks are already recorded.

Documents the office took in

Requesting a document and verifying one are the preparer's work, shown above; this is the office's own step. The office records a document it received in person for a client with no account. It is marked staff-recorded and stays awaiting preparer verification: taking delivery is not verifying, and it never changes the preparer. The one fictional file this demo accepts is demo-mileage-record-2025.pdf.

No document request on this case is waiting for a response.

Office decisions

Reminder

ViTally records office work only. It sends no email, no letter and no text message. A reminder records a nudge so the next volunteer sees this case is waiting.

A reminder is only for work nobody has claimed yet.

Close this case

Closing cancels the pending document requests and office tasks in ViTally. It does not cancel, withdraw or amend any return filed elsewhere, and it changes nothing at any tax authority.
